Skol, warriors and outcasts! I'm Savrena Krossanthym, but most know me as Kross

Daughter of Sigrun, fiercest warrior in Odin's halls. I was destined to step into my mother's role as leader of the Valkyrie when the time came

Until a moment of weakness and uncertainty was used to manipulate me. A calling to mountains of Jotunheim that promised me everything my heart desired

Deep in those mountains, hidden within a well guarded cave, I found a glowing green gem that seemed to hold the flames of Muspelheim within

As soon as I touched the gem I heard a wicked laugh within me as a pain seared through me like I'd never felt before. My body felt as though it would melt, green flames licked at my skin and burned through my veins until I fell into a merciful darkness

I was changed. Marked by the curse the gem had placed upon me. My mother, Sigrun, explained that the gem had been a prison for the most powerful dragon they'd ever met. It took everything they had just to seal it away. That the spirit of that dragon and their evil powers coursed through me, now

Fearing my new found powers, and the evil within, they banished me to Midgard

So come with me, my heathens, warriors, outcasts. All are welcome in my army. We'll make our way back to Valhalla, even if we have to take it by force
